statement: Every entry below is a blocker carried into Phase 163, each with the reason it cannot be resolved from inside this source archive. None has been downgraded by wording, and none is a test that was silenced to make the suite look better.

blockers.what: Five tests pin strategy digest c52e648ca24f... (full value c52e648ca24fb03b9ba818ebb766e32b035b48df201d5a2a1b254d04f7f3d5a6 in the tests themselves) and still FAIL against this tree.
blockers.why: The digest matches no revision recoverable from this archive or disk. The documented contract in scripts/recertify_strategy_digest.py requires the original Git checkout; it returns STATUS: BLOCKED.
blockers.effect: The five tests are correct change detectors and stay red on purpose. Re-pinning them to current bytes would destroy evidence of divergence.
blockers.unblock: Recover original Git history and re-execute research path, then run documented re-certification.

blockers.what: 40 Git-dependent facts are gated as BLOCKED_EVIDENCE by tests/evidence_mode.py.
blockers.why: No .git directory exists in this source tree. Gated so they cannot pass vacuously.
blockers.effect: Release gate for ancestry stays BLOCKED.
blockers.unblock: Deliver project as a real Git repository.

blockers.what: A vendor independent audit requires an external reviewer who did not build the bytes.
blockers.effect: No self-produced report may be read as independent third-party verification.
blockers.unblock: Hand delivery to an independent auditor with docs/CLAUDE_PHASE163_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_PROMPT.md.

blockers.what: Old-account ADAUSD LONG 1 @ 0.23327 position closure remains UNVERIFIABLE from the archive.
blockers.why: No authenticated exchange capture artifact of the closure transaction exists in the package.
blockers.effect: Cannot be marked closed without authentic venue capture.
blockers.unblock: Obtain and archive an authenticated Delta exchange order/fill capture showing closure.

blockers.what: Raw settlement cashflow debit is not independently verified in archive capture bytes.
blockers.why: hold_log.jsonl records funding_rate: 'None' and only funding_rows: 1, lacking raw debit transaction payload.
blockers.effect: Settlement debit remains UNVERIFIABLE from raw capture bytes alone.
blockers.unblock: Execute authenticated capture capturing raw exchange funding transaction JSON payload with non-null rate and verified debit.

blockers.what: Candidate B achieved MATCHED_WINDOWED, which is not full MATCHED certification.
blockers.why: 12 pre-window fills had unaligned market-friction observations and websocket sequences were null.
blockers.unblock: Execute private WebSocket capture on fresh account state with non-null sequence IDs and complete friction binding.

standing_findings.statement: No economic edge is established for any strategy revision. QuantEngine Phase 163 provides empirical protocol evidence, risk controls, and integrity verification, not profitability.
This archive deliberately contains raw private captures carrying the operator's account identifier and venue order ids. It is a restricted evidence package, not cleared for public publication.
